title: Route every event to your tenant
content:
# Route every event to your tenant

External ids on profiles, tenant routing in webhooks, a branded connect screen, deleting inbox conversations and Meta ad review status.

This week was for teams running Zernio behind their own product, with one Zernio profile per customer.

**In short:**

- Store your own customer id on a profile and look it up by that id.
- Every webhook says which of your customers it belongs to.
- The connect flow can open with your brand instead of ours.

## Your customer ids on profiles

If each of your customers gets a Zernio profile, you probably keep a table mapping their id to ours. You can drop it. Store your id on the profile once:

```bash
curl -X POST "https://zernio.com/api/v1/profiles" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZERNIO_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "name": "Acme Dental", "externalId": "tenant_4821" }'
```

Then find it with `GET /v1/profiles?externalId=tenant_4821`. Ids are unique: reusing one answers `409 profile_external_id_conflict` and points to the existing profile in `details.existingProfileId`, so a retry never creates a duplicate.

**Learn more:** [Profiles guide](/guides/profiles) · [Building a multi-tenant product](/multi-tenant) · [Create a profile](/profiles/create-profile)

## Every webhook names its customer

The other half of the mapping problem: a message arrives, and you have to work out whose it is.

Webhooks for posts, accounts, messages, conversations, comments, leads and reviews now carry a `profiles` array with your id:

```json
{
  "event": "message.received",
  "profiles": [{ "id": "6a1f0c2e9b3d4e5f6a7b8c9d", "externalId": "tenant_4821" }],
  "message": { "...": "..." }
}
```

Route the event straight to `tenant_4821`, no lookup. `externalId` is `null` on profiles without one.

**Learn more:** [Webhooks](/webhooks) · [Multi-tenant inbox](/multi-tenant/inbox)

## Your brand on the connect screen

Sending users from your app straight to an Instagram login feels like leaving your product, and some drop off there.

Add `welcome=true` to a connect link and they first see your name, logo and color, with a short explanation:

```bash
curl "https://zernio.com/api/v1/connect/instagram?profileId=PROFILE_ID&welcome=true&brandName=Acme&logoUrl=https://acme.com/logo.png&primaryColor=%23E5482D" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZERNIO_API_KEY"
```

Since October 21 you can save these once for the workspace with `PUT /v1/connect/welcome-screen` and leave the parameters out.

**Learn more:** [Connecting accounts](/guides/connecting-accounts) · [Welcome screen settings](/connect/update-connect-welcome-screen)

## Delete a conversation for good

When one of your users asks you to erase their data, you can now remove Zernio's copy of a conversation and every message in it:

```bash
curl -X DELETE "https://zernio.com/api/v1/inbox/conversations/CONVERSATION_ID?accountId=ACCOUNT_ID" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZERNIO_API_KEY"
# → { "data": { "id": "...", "platform": "whatsapp", "deletedMessages": 42 } }
```

The thread itself stays on WhatsApp, Messenger or Instagram, and the contact record is kept.

**Learn more:** [Delete a conversation](/messages/delete-inbox-conversation)

## Find out why Meta rejected an ad

Until now, seeing why an ad was refused meant opening Ads Manager. `GET /v1/ads/{adId}/review` now works on Meta ads: the live review status, Meta's feedback, and which placements were refused.

Show it next to the ad, and your users fix it without leaving your app.

**Learn more:** [Get an ad's review](/ad-campaigns/get-ad-review)

## Analytics for one campaign

Reporting on a launch used to mean collecting post ids yourself. Tag the posts when you create them, then ask for analytics on just those:

```bash
curl "https://zernio.com/api/v1/analytics?tags=launch-q4&fromDate=2026-10-01&toDate=2026-10-31" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ZERNIO_API_KEY"
```

A post must carry every listed tag (exact match, up to 20). Narrow the dates if more than 200 posts match.

**Learn more:** [Get analytics](/analytics/get-analytics)

## Also this week

- **Workflows on TikTok:** the same automations you run on other messaging platforms. [Workflows](/products/automations/workflows)
- **Meta ads:** pick the catalog ad format, keep carousel cards in your order (`optimizeCardOrder: false`), name uploaded videos, and spot ads that never appeared on the Page.
- **Other ads:** delete X Ads campaigns, recognise TikTok's automated campaigns, clearer breakdowns, and the profile on every ad.
- **Instagram:** follower counts in the account picker, and richer data when looking up other business accounts.
- **Support API:** see each run of a thread, with the question asked.
- **Worth handling:** `429` on YouTube thumbnails and analytics, `503` on WhatsApp business verification, and `502` on private replies Meta may still deliver. See [Error handling](/guides/error-handling).
